Method of Attack: Distributed via spam emails with subject 'Status of invoice' containing a 7zip (7z) attachment with a VBS file that downloads and executes the Locky ransomware executable
Encrypts files by renaming them with a specific hexadecimal ID format and appending the .ykcol extension
Removes downloaded executable after encryption and displays ransom note (ykcol.htm and ykcol.bmp)
Attempts to remove Shadow Volume Copies to prevent recovery
Attack Vector: Spam email with 7z attachment containing VBS downloader
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files with .ykcol extension and names in format [first_8_hex]-[next_4_hex]-[next_4_hex]-[4_hex]-[12_hex].ykcol
Ransom note files named ykcol.htm and ykcol.bmp
